senses.gloss: f.(b. h. גָּזֵל, גְּזֵלָה; גזל)robbery, robbed object, illegitimate gain.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 98b:14">B. Kam. 98ᵇ</cite> <he>משלם כשעת הג׳</he> he must make retribution according to the value of the object at the time it was robbed. Y. ib. X, 7ᵇ bot. <he>ג׳ מפורסמת</he> a well-known robbery or robbed object.

<cite ref="Tractate Semachot 9:19">Treat. S’maḥ. ch. IX</cite> <he>מרובה גְזֵילַת המת וכ׳</he> severer is the crime of robbery (or wrong) committed against a dead person &c.—Pl. <he>גְּזֵילוֹת</he>, <he>גְּזֵלוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 1:1">Snh. I, 1</cite> <he>ג׳ וחבלות</he> law-suits of larceny and mayhem.
<cite ref="Gittin 55b:1">Gitt. 55ᵇ</cite> that it may not be said <he>מזבח אוכל ג׳</he> the altar receives illegitimately acquired goods; Y. ib. V, 47ᵇ top.—

<cite ref="Ketubot 105a:4">Keth. 105ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 13:1">ib. XIII, 1</cite> <he>דייני ג׳</he> Y. ed. (Bab. <he>גזירות</he>) judges in suits of robbery; Bab. ib. 105ᵃ (harmonizing the two versions) <he>גוזרי גזירות על ג׳</he> decreeing fines in cases of robbery. [<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 6:6">Targ. Cant. VI, 6</cite> <cite ref="C00549"><he>גְּזֵלָה</he></cite> a. <he>גְּזֵילוֹת</he> h. forms.]
